mapper.insert: INSERT INTO semantic_hint (repo_id, hint_type, table_name, column_name, values_json, parent_table, parent_column, source_refs, source, confidence, status) VALUES (#{repoId}, #{hintType}, #{tableName}, #{columnName}, #{valuesJson}, #{parentTable}, #{parentColumn}, #{sourceRefs}, #{source}, #{confidence}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE values_json = VALUES(values_json), parent_column = VALUES(parent_column), source_refs = VALUES(source_refs), source = VALUES(source), confidence = VALUES(confidence)
mapper.sql: id, repo_id, hint_type, table_name, column_name, values_json, parent_table, parent_column, source_refs, source, confidence, status, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM semantic_hint WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE semantic_hint SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
